title: Symmetric-product line bundle and coordinate sections
statement: Let $S,X$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $n\ge1$, and $\mathrm{pr}_i:X\to\mathbf P^1_S=\mathbf P(\{0,1\};S)$ ($1\le i\le n$), using [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change]. Let $\mathcal O(1)$ and $T_0,T_1$ be the twisting sheaf and coordinate sections on $\mathbf P^1_S$ of [def-pc-projective-space-twist] (pulled back from the integral model). Put $M_i=\mathrm{pr}_i^*\mathcal O(1)$ using [def-pc-module-pullback], and $x_i=\mathrm{pr}_i^*T_0$, $y_i=\mathrm{pr}_i^*T_1$, where pullback of sections is the unit of the canonical adjunction [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Define $\mathcal L_n=M_1\otimes\cdots\otimes M_n$, with left-associated parentheses and ordered pure tensor sections as in [def-sc-positive-tensor-family]. For $0\le j\le n$ define its global section $F_j=\sum_{J\subseteq\{1,\dots,n\},\,|J|=j}u_{J,1}\otimes\cdots\otimes u_{J,n}$, where $u_{J,i}=x_i$ for $i\in J$ and $u_{J,i}=y_i$ otherwise. A top-open section is regarded as its compatible family of restrictions, and the sum of section families is transported through $\operatorname{Hom}(\mathcal O_X,\mathcal L_n)\cong\Gamma(X,\mathcal L_n)$.
